reading_note: The arc traces how divine truth descends into the natural mind to combat falsity-from-evil, clothed in successive garments of reception (the four discrete degrees: perception, natural truth, intellectual light, spiritual breath). The first descent of truth (clothed in living love) wounds the realm of self-love but is itself wounded; the matrix of spiritual life then provides four further garments as auxiliary forms by which the Divine acts in ultimates. The teaching concludes by contrasting the unified, commandment-keeping order of heaven (where every truth agrees with every other in mutual love) against the self-divided realm of self-love that abandoned its own depth and must now submit beneath the hand of the heavenly kingdom — those who align with the original Light scatter the darkness and are exalted; those who opposed it perish under the kingdom that stands against them.
